meta.title: A counter offer on a line the vendor did not quote is refused
gaps: it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the “counter the vendor's price” request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot raise a counter offer on a non quoted item.”, and never with a server error.
